verdict.rationale: EDD's own guidance pages use plain, second-person language. The enrollment page gives step-by-step instructions (select the verification link, choose a text or phone login method), and the payment page says plainly that no enrollment is needed to pay. The evidence shows only fragments of such walkthroughs, so the depth and breadth of the step-by-step guidance is unproven. Missing for 10: full step-by-step walkthroughs for core founder tasks (e.g., registering as a new employer, first payroll filing), evidence of explainers beyond task lists and form numbers like DE 88, and independent or hands-on confirmation that a non-lawyer can follow the guidance.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes plain-language, step-by-step guidance for my task — explainers a non-lawyer can follow, not just statute text and form numbers

citations.quote: Select the verification link in the email we sent you to complete the enrollment process.
Select Text Message or Phone Call to set up an additional login verification method or select use my email instead.
Make a payroll tax payment. No enrollment is necessary to use this service.
Register, close, or re-open an employer payroll tax account.
